description: Create a new calendar event in Nextcloud with date/time, location, description, attendees, and optional recurrence.

alarm.description: Single reminder in minutes before the event (e.g. 15 for 15 min before). For multiple reminders use alarms[].

alarms.description: Multiple reminders in minutes before the event (e.g. [1440, 60] for 1 day and 1 hour before). Combined with alarm if both are set.

calendarName.description: The calendar name. Use list_calendars to find available calendar names.

dtend.description: End date/time. For all-day events, this is the exclusive end date (day after last day). If omitted, defaults to 1 hour after start (timed) or next day (all-day).

dtstart.description: Start date/time in YYYYMMDD (all-day) or YYYYMMDDTHHmmssZ (timed) format

transp.description: Time transparency for free/busy (OPAQUE = busy, TRANSPARENT = free)

tzid.description: IANA time zone (e.g. "Europe/Berlin"). When set, a VTIMEZONE block is emitted and dtstart/dtend use TZID instead of UTC. Required for reliable iOS Calendar and Thunderbird CalDAV sync of timed events. UTC inputs (trailing Z) are converted to wall-clock time in this zone.

name: create_event
title: Create Calendar Event
